is_property_of.description: Inverse of for_property: links the Class Signal to the Class of SignalBinding Procedure that implements it. Values are typically the ControlSystem that implements this binding, e.g. narad:epics (for EPICS control system). NOTE: The value of this slot must match one of the values in narad_config.has_sub_system.
